thesis: The page is a lab ledger of one roof's water: a glass measuring cylinder fills as you read, and every section pours its gallons into it, so the homeowner watches the same arithmetic Gallonworks writes on the estimate.

signature.name: Rain Cylinder Ledger
signature.summary: A graduated glass cylinder (SVG outline, mono ticks, yellow fill via --sw-p) paired with mono ledger rows with dotted leaders and right-aligned gallon numerals; in the hero it repeats as a slow filmstrip of sample cylinders between photo frames, splits into downspout drops in the pour story, takes the runoff calculator answer, shrinks to chips on review cards, and spills into a drawn rain barrel in the footer.

palette.family: Wet Cedar Evergreen + Rain Glass + Cylinder Yellow

layoutMoves: 72px left margin column holding the fixed page cylinder on desktop
mono ledger rows with dotted leaders instead of cards for prices and services
hero filmstrip alternating drawn sample cylinders and the rain photo, under a statement
pinned pour diagram where one cylinder splits into downspout drops

motion.intro: h1 line mask rises, the hero cylinder fills to the 1 in tick while 0 counts to 623, then the filmstrip starts its slow drift (<=1.1s, final state in DOM)
stories: pour: pinned 4-step diagram, cylinder drains into 1 then 2 drawn downspouts with per-drop ledger counts
count: margin cylinder fills with page progress; each ledger numeral counts up once in view
motion.hover: water level: a fill rises from the bottom of buttons and cards (scaleY 0 to 1, 200ms)
